services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Each service has its own order form. Doctors can place orders only on services with a published form.
services.empty: No services yet. Add your first one to start receiving orders.

create.title: Create service
create.pickTemplateHelp: Pick a starting point. You can enable/disable individual fields and set pricing in the next section.
create.customizeHelp: Toggle which fields doctors must fill in, and set the unit or fixed price.
create.pricingRequiredForPublish: Set a price (and at least one material with a unit price for Crown & Bridge) before publishing this service.

edit.title: Edit service
edit.templateLocked: Locked — historical orders depend on this template.
edit.cnbFieldsLocked: Crown & Bridge uses a structured form — its fields are fixed. Configure pricing in the Pricing tab.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this service?
deleteConfirm.body: Existing orders for this service are not affected. The service will simply disappear from your catalog.

forms.title: Order forms
forms.subtitle: Create a form per service so doctors can place structured orders.
forms.empty: No forms yet. Create your first one from a platform template.

editor.fieldsHelp: Toggle fields on/off, mark as required, and add helper text.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.materialsHelp: Define up to 5 materials. Each material has its own unit price. The doctor picks one material per tooth; the total adds up the selected materials' prices.
pricing.rushTurnaroundDaysHelp: Faster turnaround when the doctor pays the rush surcharge.
pricing.rushTurnaroundDaysMax_one: Up to 1 day (your service's average turnaround).
pricing.rushTurnaroundDaysMax_other: Up to {{count}} days (your service's average turnaround).

publishConfirm.title: Publish this form?
publishConfirm.body: Once published, doctors can use this form to place orders. Each subsequent edit creates a new immutable version — historical orders keep using the version they were submitted with.

editor.publishedNotice: This form is published. Saving will create a new version.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.comingSoon: Order intake will appear here once your laboratory is approved.

orderSheet.finalPriceTooLow: Final price cannot be lower than {{min}} (50% of the estimated total).
orderSheet.statusHelp: Pick the new status and click Save. The doctor sees the change immediately.

PENDING_APPROVAL.body: Complete your laboratory profile and submit it for approval. You will become visible to doctors after a platform admin approves your laboratory.

REJECTED.body: Your laboratory registration was rejected. Please contact support.

SUSPENDED.title: Laboratory suspended
SUSPENDED.body: Your laboratory has been suspended and cannot receive new orders. Please contact support.
